source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 14 (PDF 18-44), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 14 (Simple Harmonic Motion) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is oscillatory motion? Give two examples.
(Oscillatory motion kya hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Oscillatory motion mean position ke gird aage peeche ki motion hai; yeh periodic hai aur barabar waqfon ke baad dohrati hai. Misalein: vibrate karta tuning fork; spring ke sire par oscillate karta mass.

book_ref.quote: Oscillatory motion is a to and fro motion about its mean position

blocks.prompt:
2 What causes a displaced body to oscillate about its mean position?
(Hataya gaya jism apni mean position ke gird kyun oscillate karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab jism ko mean (equilibrium) position se hataya jaata hai to us par restoring force (wapas laane wali quwwat) amal karti hai jo usay wapas laati hai. Yehi force oscillation paida karti hai.

book_ref.quote: All the bodies that undergo vibrational or oscillation motion have an equilibrium position or mean position

blocks.prompt:
3 Name four natural phenomena that show periodic motion.
(Qudrat ke chaar mazahir ke naam likhein jo periodic motion dikhate hain.)
blocks.explanation: Zameen ka Suraj ke gird chakkar, Chaand ka Zameen ke gird chakkar, paani ki lehrein aur sound waves (aur tuning fork, jhoolne wali kursi).

book_ref.quote: Many natural phenomena show periodic motion.

blocks.prompt:
4 Define vibration. What is one vibration of a simple pendulum swinging between A and B?
(Vibration ki definition likhein. A aur B ke darmiyan jhoolte simple pendulum ki aik vibration kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mean position ke gird vibrate karne wale jism ka aik mukammal chakkar (cycle) vibration kehlata hai. Pendulum ke liye bob ka A se B aur wapas B se A tak jaana (mean position se guzarte hue) aik vibration hai.

book_ref.quote: One complete round trip (cycle) of vibrating body about its mean position is called vibration

blocks.prompt:
5 Differentiate between instantaneous displacement and amplitude.
(Instantaneous displacement aur amplitude mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Displacement har lamhe badalta hai; amplitude us ki muqarrar zyada se zyada qeemat hai.

book_ref.quote: The magnitude of the maximum displacement of the vibrating body on either side of its mean position

rows: Kisi lamhe mean position se vibrate karne wale jism ka faasla.
Mean position ke kisi bhi taraf zyada se zyada displacement ki miqdaar.
Motion ke dauran musalsal badalta hai (mean position par sifar).
Kisi oscillation ke liye muqarrar (agar damping na ho).
Pendulum mein: OC = x.
Pendulum mein: OA = OB = x₀.

blocks.prompt:
6 How is the amplitude of a wave related to the energy it carries?
(Wave ke amplitude aur us ki energy ka kya taalluq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amplitude wave ki energy ka paimana hai: amplitude jitna zyada, wave utni zyada energy le jaati hai, aur ulta bhi.

book_ref.quote: Amplitude of a wave measures the energy carried by a wave.

blocks.prompt:
7 A pendulum has amplitude 5 cm. What distance does the bob cover in 3 complete vibrations?
(Pendulum ka amplitude 5 cm hai. 3 mukammal vibrations mein bob kitna faasla tay karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik vibration mein bob 4 amplitude ke barabar chalta hai: 4x₀ = 4 × 5 cm = 20 cm. 3 vibrations mein: 3 × 20 cm = 60 cm.

book_ref.quote: If x₀ is the amplitude of simple pendulum

blocks.prompt:
8 Define frequency and its SI unit. Give its dimension.
(Frequency aur us ki SI unit ki definition likhein. Dimension bhi likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Frequency fi second mukammal hone wali vibrations ki tadaad hai: f = n/t = 1/T. Unit hertz (Hz); aik hertz yani aik oscillation fi second. Dimension: [T⁻¹].

book_ref.quote: Frequency is defined as the number of vibrations or oscillations (n) completed by the vibrating body in one second

blocks.prompt:
9 A mass on a spring makes 30 vibrations in 12 s. Find its time period and frequency.
(Spring par mass 12 s mein 30 vibrations karta hai. Time period aur frequency nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: A fish connected to a spring makes 10 vibrations in 20 seconds

blocks.prompt:
10 Define angular frequency and show that ω = 2πf.
(Angular frequency ki definition likhein aur dikhayein ke ω = 2πf.)
blocks.explanation: Angular frequency fi unit waqt angular displacement hai: ω = θ/t. Aik chakkar mein θ = 2π rad aur t = T, is liye ω = 2π/T. f = 1/T, to ω = 2πf. Unit: rad s⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: Angular displacement per unit time is called angular frequency

blocks.prompt:
11 Differentiate between frequency and angular frequency.
(Frequency aur angular frequency mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono ki dimension [T⁻¹] hai; ω = 2πf.

book_ref.quote: The SI unit of angular frequency is rad s⁻¹ and its dimension is [T⁻¹].

rows: Aik second mein mukammal vibrations ki tadaad.
Fi unit waqt angular displacement.
f = n/t = 1/T
ω = θ/t = 2π/T
Unit: hertz (Hz).
Unit: rad s⁻¹.
f = ω/2π
ω = 2πf

blocks.prompt:
12 A particle in S.H.M has angular frequency 6 rad s⁻¹. Find its frequency and time period.
(S.H.M mein particle ki angular frequency 6 rad s⁻¹ hai. Frequency aur time period nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: A particle executing simple harmonic motion has an angular frequency of 2 rad s⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
13 Write the mathematical form of S.H.M and explain the meaning of its negative sign.
(S.H.M ki riyazi shakal likhein aur manfi nishaan ka matlab batayein.)
blocks.explanation: a ∝ −x (a = −ω²x): acceleration mean position se displacement ke seedhe tanasub mein hai. Manfi nishaan batata hai ke acceleration hamesha displacement ke ulat, yani mean position ki taraf hai.

book_ref.quote: Simple harmonic motion is a type of oscillation or vibratory motion produced under the action of restoring force.

blocks.prompt:
14 Are all periodic vibrations simple harmonic? Give an example.
(Kya har periodic vibration simple harmonic hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Har restoring force oscillation de sakti hai, magar S.H.M ke liye force displacement ke proportional honi chahiye. ECG ki needle periodic pattern banati hai magar us ki restoring force hamesha displacement ke proportional nahi, is liye yeh S.H.M nahi.

book_ref.quote: not all periodic vibrations are examples of simple harmonic motion

blocks.prompt:
15 What is the role of inertia in simple harmonic motion?
(Simple harmonic motion mein inertia ka kya kirdaar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Restoring force sirf displacement par munhasar hai (F = −kx), inertia (jumood) par nahi. Phir bhi inertia zaroori hai: yeh jism ko mean position se aage le jaata hai jahan force sifar hoti hai, is tarah oscillation jaari rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: The restoring force is not proportional to the inertia (mass) of the body

blocks.prompt:
16 State Hooke's law for a spring. Why is the restoring force written as F = −kx?
(Spring ke liye Hooke's law bayan karein. Restoring force F = −kx kyun likhi jaati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hooke's law: lagayi gayi force displacement ke proportional hai, F = kx. Spring barabar magar ulti simt mein elastic restoring force lagata hai, is liye F = −kx.

book_ref.quote: According to Hooke's law, the applied force is proportional to displacement

blocks.prompt:
17 What is the spring constant? On what does it depend? Give its SI unit.
(Spring constant kya hai? Yeh kis par munhasar hai? SI unit likhein.)
blocks.explanation: F = kx se spring constant k = F/x, yani fi unit khinchao force. Yeh spring ki nature (material, shakal aur banawat) par munhasar hai. SI unit: N m⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: where 'k' is spring constant depending upon the nature (physical shape and structure of a spring)

blocks.prompt:
18 A spring of constant 250 N m⁻¹ is compressed by 3 cm. Find the restoring force and its direction.
(250 N m⁻¹ spring 3 cm daba diya gaya. Restoring force aur us ki simt nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: F = −kx = −250 × (−0.03) = +7.5 N. Miqdaar 7.5 N; yeh dabao ke ulat, yani mean position ki taraf hai.

book_ref.quote: The spring will exert the force on the body due to elastic restoring force

blocks.prompt:
19 Show that a mass attached to a horizontal spring has a ∝ −x.
(Dikhayein ke ufuqi spring se bandhe mass ke liye a ∝ −x hai.)
blocks.explanation: Restoring force F = −kx aur Newton ke doosre qanoon se F = ma. To ma = −kx, a = −(k/m)x. k/m constant hai, is liye a ∝ −x, jo S.H.M ki riyazi shakal hai.

book_ref.quote: The negative sign shows that acceleration and displacement are always in opposite direction

blocks.prompt:
20 Why does a mass on a spring not stop at the mean position when released?
(Chhorne par spring par laga mass mean position par kyun nahi rukta?)
blocks.explanation: Mean position par restoring force sifar hai, magar wahan mass ki velocity zyada se zyada hai. Inertia ki wajah se yeh O se aage B tak jaata hai, spring dabata hai aur laut aata hai; is tarah A aur B ke beech oscillate karta rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: it will move towards 'O' and will cross the mean position O due to inertia

blocks.prompt:
21 Write the time period of a mass-spring system. How does it change with mass and with spring constant?
(Mass-spring system ka time period likhein. Mass aur spring constant ke saath yeh kaise badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: T = 2π√(m/k). Bhaari mass lamba period deta hai (T ∝ √m); sakht spring (zyada k) chhota period deta hai (T ∝ 1/√k).

book_ref.quote: T is the reciprocal of f = (1/2π)√(k/m), so m/k comes under the root

blocks.prompt:
22 A 0.2 kg mass oscillates on a spring of constant 80 N m⁻¹. Find ω, f and T.
(0.2 kg mass 80 N m⁻¹ spring par oscillate karta hai. ω, f aur T nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The last line should read T = 1/f = 2π√(m/k)

blocks.prompt:
23 Name three real-world applications that use the principle of S.H.M.
(S.H.M ke usool ke teen amli istemal ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Pendulum clocks, musical instruments aur gaariyon ka suspension system.

book_ref.quote: Real world applications that utilize S.H.M principle include

blocks.prompt:
24 What is a simple pendulum?
(Simple pendulum kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Simple pendulum aik chhote bhaari thos bob (mass m) par mushtamil hai jo halki inextensible (na khinchne wali) dori se rigid support se latka ho. Hata kar chhorne par yeh gravity ke zere asar mean position ke gird oscillate karta hai.

book_ref.quote: A simple pendulum consists of a small heavy solid bob of mass m suspended from a rigid support

blocks.prompt:
25 Which force provides the restoring force for a simple pendulum, and what happens to the other component of weight?
(Simple pendulum mein restoring force kaun deta hai, aur weight ke doosre component ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Weight mg ko θ angle par tod kar dekhein. mg sinθ mean position ki taraf restoring force hai (F = −mg sinθ). mg cosθ dori ke saath hai aur tension T se cancel ho jaata hai kyun ke dori ke rukh koi motion nahi.

book_ref.quote: As the pendulum has no motion along the direction of the string

blocks.prompt:
26 Why must the angle of a simple pendulum be small for its motion to be S.H.M?
(Simple pendulum ki motion S.H.M ho, is ke liye angle chhota kyun hona chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Acceleration a = −g sinθ aam taur par displacement ke proportional nahi. Sirf chhote angles (taqreeban 10° ya kam) par sinθ ≈ θ (radians mein) aur x ≈ arc S, jis se a = −(g/ℓ)x, yani a ∝ −x.

book_ref.quote: For small angles sinθ ≈ θ (θ in radians)

blocks.prompt:
27 Use Table 14.1 to show that sinθ ≈ θ for 5°.
(Table 14.1 se dikhayein ke 5° ke liye sinθ ≈ θ hai.)
blocks.explanation: Table se 5° = 0.0873 rad aur sin 5° = 0.0872. Farq sirf 0.0001 (taqreeban 0.1 %), is liye chhote angles par sinθ ki jagah θ (radians) likha ja sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Table 14.1: Values of θ and sinθ for small angle

blocks.prompt:
28 On what factors does the time period of a simple pendulum depend, and on what does it not depend?
(Simple pendulum ka time period kin cheezon par munhasar hai aur kin par nahi?)
blocks.explanation: T = 2π√(ℓ/g). T √ℓ ke seedhe aur √g ke ulte tanasub mein hai. Yeh bob ke mass aur (chhote) amplitude se azaad hai.

book_ref.quote: The time period of motion of the pendulum is independent of the mass m of the bob and amplitude.

blocks.prompt:
29 What is a second pendulum? What is its frequency?
(Second pendulum kya hai? Is ki frequency kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jo pendulum aik vibration do second mein mukammal kare (T = 2 s) woh second pendulum hai. Frequency f = 1/T = 0.5 Hz.

book_ref.quote: A pendulum that completes one vibration in two seconds

blocks.prompt:
30 Find the time period of a simple pendulum of length 0.4 m (g = 9.8 m s⁻²).
(0.4 m lambe simple pendulum ka time period nikalein (g = 9.8 m s⁻²).)

book_ref.quote: The above expression shows that the time period of simple pendulum is directly proportional to the square root

blocks.prompt:
31 How can a simple pendulum be used to find g at a place?
(Simple pendulum se kisi jagah g kaise maloom kiya ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pendulum ki lambai ℓ naapein, chhote amplitude se jhulaayein aur stopwatch se time period T naapein. Phir g = 4π²ℓ/T² (T = 2π√(ℓ/g) se).

book_ref.quote: We measure the length 'ℓ' of the pendulum and then set the pendulum into motion.

blocks.prompt:
32 A pendulum 1.0 m long has a time period of 3.0 s on a planet. Find g on that planet.
(Aik planet par 1.0 m lambe pendulum ka time period 3.0 s hai. Us planet par g nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: the acceleration due to gravity is calculated by using Eq. (14.10)

blocks.prompt:
33 Find the length of a pendulum whose time period is 4 s (g = 9.8 m s⁻²).
(Us pendulum ki lambai nikalein jis ka time period 4 s ho (g = 9.8 m s⁻²).)

book_ref.quote: Also find its frequency at a place where the value of g is taken to be 9.8 m s⁻²

blocks.prompt:
34 Would a pendulum of fixed length have the same time period on the Earth and on the Moon? Explain.
(Kya muqarrar lambai ke pendulum ka time period Zameen aur Chaand par aik jaisa hoga? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. T = 2π√(ℓ/g), yani T ∝ 1/√g. Chaand par g Zameen se kam hai, is liye wahan wohi pendulum lamba time period dega.

book_ref.quote: Would the time period of a simple pendulum be same on Earth and moon

blocks.prompt:
35 Differentiate between the mass-spring system and the simple pendulum as S.H.M systems.
(S.H.M systems ke taur par mass-spring system aur simple pendulum mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono a ∝ −x par chalte hain, magar forces aur constants mukhtalif hain.

book_ref.quote: Comparing Eqs. (14.7) and (14.8), we have

rows: Restoring force spring ki elastic force hai, F = −kx.
Restoring force mg sinθ hai, weight ka component.
a = −(k/m)x
a = −(g/ℓ)x (chhote angles)
T mass par munhasar hai.
T bob ke mass se azaad hai.

blocks.text: 14.4 Simple Harmonic Motion and Uniform Circular Motion

blocks.prompt:
36 How can the shadow of a ball on a turntable be used to show S.H.M?
(Turntable par lagi gend ke saaye se S.H.M kaise dikhayi ja sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Turntable constant ω se ghoome to rim par lagi gend uniform circular motion karti hai. Roshni ki shuaa us ka saaya screen par daalti hai; saaya screen par aage peeche S.H.M karta hai, spring wale jism ki tarah.

book_ref.quote: consider a turntable of radius r with a ball attached to its rim

blocks.prompt:
37 Write the instantaneous displacement of the projection of a particle in uniform circular motion and explain the symbols.
(Uniform circular motion wale particle ke projection ka instantaneous displacement likhein aur symbols batayein.)
blocks.explanation: x = x₀ cos θ = x₀ cos ωt; x₀ circle ka radius (amplitude), ω yaksaan angular velocity, t point A se waqt aur θ = ωt radius OP ka tay kiya angle.

book_ref.quote: Equation (14.11) gives the instantaneous displacement of point Q

blocks.prompt:
38 Where is the speed of a body in S.H.M maximum and where is it zero? Give reasons.
(S.H.M mein jism ki speed kahan zyada se zyada aur kahan sifar hoti hai? Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: v = ω√(x₀² − x²). Mean position par x = 0, to v = x₀ω (zyada se zyada). Extreme positions par x = ±x₀, to v = 0.

book_ref.quote: Eq. (14.13) should read v = ω√(x₀² − x²)

blocks.prompt:
39 A body in S.H.M has amplitude 0.10 m and ω = 8 rad s⁻¹. Find its speed at x = 0.08 m.
(S.H.M mein jism ka amplitude 0.10 m aur ω = 8 rad s⁻¹ hai. x = 0.08 m par speed nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: the print drops the square on the first x₀

blocks.prompt:
40 Show that the acceleration of the projection of a particle in uniform circular motion satisfies a ∝ −x.
(Dikhayein ke uniform circular motion wale particle ke projection ka acceleration a ∝ −x par poora utarta hai.)
blocks.explanation: P ka centripetal acceleration centre ki taraf hai; us ka horizontal component Q ka acceleration hai: a = −x₀ω² cosθ = −x₀ω²(x/x₀) = −ω²x. ω constant hai, is liye a ∝ −x; projection S.H.M karta hai.

book_ref.quote: This expression is the mathematical condition of S.H.M

blocks.prompt:
41 A 0.4 kg mass on a spring of constant 16 N m⁻¹ has amplitude 0.1 m. Find its acceleration and speed at x = 0.06 m.
(0.4 kg mass 16 N m⁻¹ spring par 0.1 m amplitude rakhta hai. x = 0.06 m par acceleration aur speed nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: A 0.2 kg mass is attached to a spring with a spring constant of 10 N m⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
42 Define phase. What is the phase constant?
(Phase ki definition likhein. Phase constant kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phase woh angle θ = ωt (aam taur par ωt + φ) hai jo S.H.M mein displacement aur motion ki simt batata hai; yeh motion ki haalat dikhata hai. x = x₀ cos(ωt + φ) mein constant φ phase constant hai jo t = 0 par displacement aur velocity par munhasar hai.

book_ref.quote: The angle θ = ωt which specifies the displacements x as well as the direction of motion

blocks.prompt:
43 Differentiate between oscillations in phase and out of phase.
(In phase aur out of phase oscillations mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq do systems ke phase difference mein hai.

book_ref.quote: When the phase difference between two oscillating systems is 180°

rows: Phase difference 0° ya 360°.
Phase difference 180°.
Dono aik hi extreme par saath pohnchte hain.
Jab aik +x₀ par ho to doosra −x₀ par.
Displacements ka nishaan hamesha aik jaisa.
Displacements ke nishaan hamesha ulte.

blocks.prompt:
44 Where is the oscillating point at t = 0 when φ = 0° and when φ = 90°?
(φ = 0° aur φ = 90° ke liye t = 0 par oscillating point kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: x = x₀ cos(ωt + φ). φ = 0° par x = x₀: point extreme position se shuru hota hai. φ = 90° par x = 0: point mean position se shuru hota hai.

book_ref.quote: If φ = 90°, then Eq. (14.18) becomes:

blocks.prompt:
45 For x = x₀ cos(ωt + 180°), find the displacement at t = 0 and t = T/2.
(x = x₀ cos(ωt + 180°) ke liye t = 0 aur t = T/2 par displacement nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: t = 0 par x = x₀ cos 180° = −x₀. t = T/2 par ωt = π, x = x₀ cos 360° = +x₀. Point manfi extreme se shuru hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Putting t = 0, T/4, T/2, 3T/4, T ...., we obtain a graph

blocks.prompt:
46 A body oscillates as x = 0.2 cos ωt with T = 2 s. Find its phase and displacement at t = 0.25 s.
(Jism x = 0.2 cos ωt ke mutabiq oscillate karta hai, T = 2 s. t = 0.25 s par phase aur displacement nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Where x is instantaneous displacement, x₀ is maximum displacement

blocks.prompt:
47 What is the phase difference between (i) velocity and displacement (ii) acceleration and displacement in S.H.M?
(S.H.M mein (i) velocity aur displacement (ii) acceleration aur displacement ka phase difference kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: (i) Velocity aur displacement mein π/2 ka phase difference hai. (ii) a = −ω²x, is liye acceleration hamesha displacement ke ulat; phase difference π.

book_ref.quote: The phase difference between velocity and displacement is π/2.

blocks.prompt:
48 Why is the acceleration of a body in S.H.M maximum at the extreme positions?
(S.H.M mein jism ka acceleration extreme positions par zyada se zyada kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: a = −ω²x, yani acceleration ki miqdaar displacement ke proportional hai. Extremes par displacement zyada se zyada (x₀) hai, is liye |a| = x₀ω²; mean position par x = 0 aur a = 0.

book_ref.quote: The acceleration will be maximum (i.e., x₀ω²) at the extreme positions

blocks.prompt:
49 Write the equations of displacement, velocity and acceleration for x = x₀ cos ωt.
(x = x₀ cos ωt ke liye displacement, velocity aur acceleration ki equations likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Displacement: x = x₀ cos ωt. Velocity: v = −x₀ω sin ωt (miqdaar x₀ω sin ωt). Acceleration: a = −x₀ω² cos ωt.

book_ref.quote: For x = x₀ cos ωt the velocity is v = −x₀ω sin ωt, so it falls first

blocks.prompt:
50 A body moves in S.H.M with amplitude 0.05 m and frequency 4 Hz. Find its maximum speed and maximum acceleration.
(Jism 0.05 m amplitude aur 4 Hz frequency se S.H.M karta hai. Zyada se zyada speed aur acceleration nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The velocity of the particle is maximum (i.e., v = x₀ω) at the mean position

blocks.prompt:
51 Why is the average force ½kx₀ used to find the work done in stretching a spring?
(Spring khenchne ka kaam nikalne ke liye average force ½kx₀ kyun li jaati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Restoring force constant nahi: x = 0 par sifar aur x = x₀ par kx₀, yaksaan barhti hai. Is liye average force (0 + kx₀)/2 = ½kx₀ aur W = ½kx₀ × x₀ = ½kx₀².

book_ref.quote: Thus, average value of force from the mean position to the extreme position is:

blocks.prompt:
52 A spring of constant 150 N m⁻¹ oscillates with amplitude 6 cm. Find its P.E. and K.E. at x = 4 cm.
(150 N m⁻¹ spring 6 cm amplitude se oscillate karta hai. x = 4 cm par P.E. aur K.E. nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: This work done on the mass attached to a spring is stored in terms of potential energy

blocks.prompt:
53 Differentiate between the kinetic energy and potential energy of a mass-spring oscillator.
(Mass-spring oscillator ki kinetic energy aur potential energy mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono ka majmooa constant hai: K.E. + P.E. = ½kx₀².

book_ref.quote: When a body is executing simple harmonic motion, it possesses both potential energy as well as kinetic energy.

rows: Mass ki velocity ki wajah se.
Mean position se displacement ki wajah se (elastic P.E.).
K.E. = ½k(x₀² − x²)
P.E. = ½kx²
Mean position par zyada se zyada (½kx₀²).
Extreme positions par zyada se zyada (½kx₀²).
Extreme positions par sifar.
Mean position par sifar.

blocks.prompt:
54 Show that the total energy of a mass-spring system is independent of the displacement x.
(Dikhayein ke mass-spring system ki kul energy displacement x se azaad hai.)
blocks.explanation: T.E = ½k(x₀² − x²) + ½kx² = ½kx₀². x² wale terms cancel ho jaate hain, is liye T.E sirf k aur amplitude x₀ par munhasar hai, x par nahi; yeh constant aur x₀² ke proportional hai.

book_ref.quote: it is proved that total energy of mass spring system is constant

blocks.prompt:
55 Express the total energy of an oscillator in terms of m, ω and x₀ and find it for m = 0.5 kg, ω = 4 rad s⁻¹, x₀ = 0.1 m.
(Oscillator ki kul energy m, ω aur x₀ ki shakal mein likhein aur m = 0.5 kg, ω = 4 rad s⁻¹, x₀ = 0.1 m ke liye nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: T.E = ½kx₀² aur k = mω², to T.E = ½mω²x₀² = ½ × 0.5 × 16 × 0.01 = 0.04 J.

book_ref.quote: Eq. (14.29) should read T.E = ½mω²x₀²

blocks.prompt:
56 At what displacement is the energy of an oscillator half kinetic and half potential?
(Kis displacement par oscillator ki energy aadhi kinetic aur aadhi potential hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: P.E. = ½ T.E: ½kx² = ½(½kx₀²), to x² = x₀²/2, x = x₀/√2 = 0.707x₀ mean position ke kisi bhi taraf.

book_ref.quote: The energy oscillates between K.E. and P.E., but their sum remains constant.

blocks.prompt:
57 A 0.4 kg mass on a spring of constant 90 N m⁻¹ oscillates with amplitude 0.08 m. Find its maximum speed.
(0.4 kg mass 90 N m⁻¹ spring par 0.08 m amplitude se oscillate karta hai. Zyada se zyada speed nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: At mean position x = 0, the mass gets maximum velocity

blocks.prompt:
58 What are free vibrations? Give two examples.
(Free vibrations kya hain? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Jab jism bairooni force ki madakhlat ke baghair apni natural frequency se oscillate kare to yeh free vibrations hain. Misalein: thora hata kar chhora gaya simple pendulum; guitar ki string (aur bajti ghanti).

book_ref.quote: A body is said to be executing free vibrations if it oscillates with its natural frequency

blocks.prompt:
59 Why does the amplitude of an ideal free oscillation remain constant?
(Misaali free oscillation ka amplitude constant kyun rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rukawat ki force na ho to free oscillation mein energy zaaya nahi hoti, kul energy constant rehti hai. T.E = ½kx₀², is liye energy constant to amplitude bhi constant.

book_ref.quote: In free oscillations, the total energy of the body remains constant

blocks.prompt:
60 Give three examples of forced vibrations.
(Forced vibrations ki teen misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Baar baar dhakka diya gaya jhoola; bhaari machinery se factory ke farsh ki thartharahat; string instruments ke lakri ke boards jo buland music dete hain (aur engine se gaari ki thartharahat).

book_ref.quote: Another example of forced vibration is loud music produced by sounding wooden boards

blocks.prompt:
61 What are damped oscillations? Why does a real swing finally stop?
(Damped oscillations kya hain? Asal jhoola aakhir kyun ruk jaata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rukawat (damping) forces ki maujoodgi mein ghatte amplitude wali oscillations damped oscillations hain. Hawa ki rukawat aur friction jhoole ki energy zaaya karte hain, amplitude kam hota jaata hai aur aakhir jhoola ruk jaata hai.

book_ref.quote: The oscillations with decreasing amplitude in the presence of various resistive forces are called damped oscillations

blocks.prompt:
62 Differentiate between free (ideal) oscillations and damped oscillations.
(Free (misaali) oscillations aur damped oscillations mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq yeh hai ke energy rukawat ki forces mein zaaya hoti hai ya nahi.

book_ref.quote: In an ideal free oscillation system, we have studied that the total mechanical energy

rows: Koi rukawat ki force nahi.
Hawa ki rukawat aur friction jaisi forces amal karti hain.
Kul mechanical energy constant rehti hai.
Energy aahista aahista zaaya hoti hai.
Amplitude constant rehta hai.
Amplitude waqt ke saath ghatta hai, jism ruk jaata hai.

blocks.prompt:
63 Differentiate between light damping and critical damping.
(Light damping aur critical damping mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq yeh hai ke jism kitni jaldi equilibrium par aata hai.

book_ref.quote: Light damping: It reduces gradually the energy and amplitude of vibrating body.

rows: Energy aur amplitude aahista kam hote hain; jism kuch der oscillate karta rehta hai.
Jism kam se kam waqt mein equilibrium par laut aata hai.
Misaal: playground ka jhoola.
Misaal: car ke shock absorbers.

blocks.prompt:
64 Why is a damping system needed in the suspension of a car?
(Car ke suspension mein damping system kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kharab, ooncha neecha raasta car ke springs mein zyada oscillations paida karta hai. Shock absorbers in oscillations ko damp karte hain taake musafiron ka safar aaraam deh ho.

book_ref.quote: Damping system is required to ensure a comfortable ride for the passengers

blocks.prompt:
65 What are driving force and driving frequency?
(Driving force aur driving frequency kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Oscillator ka amplitude constant rakhne ke liye lagayi gayi periodic bairooni force driving force hai. Is se paida hone wali oscillation forced oscillation aur us ki frequency driving frequency hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus, when the oscillating body is subjected to a periodic driving force

blocks.prompt:
66 Define resonance and give one example from daily life.
(Resonance ki definition likhein aur rozmarra zindagi ki aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Jab driving force ki frequency jism ki natural frequency ke barabar ho to vibration ka amplitude bohat barh jaata hai; yeh resonance (gunj) hai. Misaal: jhoole ko us ki natural frequency par dhakka dene se amplitude barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: This phenomenon is known as resonance.

blocks.prompt:
67 In the pendulum experiment, why do C and D stay almost at rest when P (length ℓ₁) swings?
(Pendulum wale tajrube mein jab P (lambai ℓ₁) jhoolta hai to C aur D taqreeban kyun ruke rehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: P ki vibration rod ke zariye sab tak pohnchti hai, magar C aur D ki lambai ℓ₂ hai aur un ki natural frequency P se mukhtalif hai. Un ke liye resonance nahi hoti; sirf A aur B (lambai ℓ₁) resonate karte hain.

book_ref.quote: At the same time, the pendulums C and D whose natural frequencies are different

blocks.prompt:
68 How does a microwave oven heat food by resonance?
(Microwave oven resonance se khaana kaise garam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oven ki microwaves (taqreeban 2.45 GHz) khaane ke paani ke molecules ko usi frequency par hilaati hain; molecules aapas mein takraate hain. Takkar ki friction un ki kinetic energy ko heat mein badalti hai.

book_ref.quote: Friction generated by the collisions changes the kinetic energy of the water into heat

blocks.prompt:
69 How is resonance used in tuning a radio?
(Radio tune karne mein resonance kaise istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Knob ghumaane se receiver ke electrical circuit ki natural frequency badalti hai. Jab yeh station ki transmission frequency ke barabar ho to resonance hoti hai aur receiver us station se zyada se zyada energy leta hai; sirf wohi station sunayi deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The tuning of an analogue radio set for a certain station is also based on resonance

blocks.prompt:
70 Why can resonance be dangerous for an aeroplane wing?
(Aeroplane ke par ke liye resonance khatarnaak kyun ho sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paron par aerodynamic forces, turbulence aur engine ki vibration amal karti hain. Agar in ki frequency paron ki natural frequency se mil jaye to resonance amplitude bohat barha deti hai jo khatarnaak ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: When the frequencies of these forces are matching with the natural frequency of the wings

blocks.prompt:
71 Why does a guitar or violin have a hollow wooden box?
(Guitar ya violin mein khokhla lakri ka dabba kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Vibrate karti string apni energy khokhle sound box ko deti hai jo string ke saath resonate karta hai. Is se sound waves buland hoti hain aur aawaz zyada oonchi aur bharpoor hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: The sound box resonants, amplifying the sound waves.

blocks.prompt:
72 How is resonance used in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)?
(Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) mein resonance kaise istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: MRI mein taqatwar radio frequency radiations nuclei ko oscillate karwaati hain aur nuclei energy absorb karte hain. Absorb hui energy ke pattern se computer ki madad se tasveer banti hai jo bimari ki tashkhees mein kaam aati hai.

book_ref.quote: strong radio frequency radiations are used to cause nuclei to oscillate

blocks.prompt:
73 How does a Rubens tube show the nodes and antinodes of a standing wave?
(Rubens tube standing wave ke nodes aur antinodes kaise dikhati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Resonance frequency par gas bhari tube mein standing wave banti hai. Jahan pressure zyada wahan suraakhon se zyada gas nikalti hai aur shola ooncha hota hai; jahan kam wahan neecha. Ooche shole pressure antinodes par, aadhi wavelength ke faasle par hote hain.

book_ref.quote: The standing wave creates points with oscillating (higher and lower) pressure within the tube.

blocks.prompt:
74 Why does sand collect along certain lines on a vibrating Chladni plate?
(Vibrate karti Chladni plate par ret kuch khaas lakeeron par kyun jama hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Resonant frequency par plate par nodes aur antinodes bante hain. Nodes par plate vibrate nahi karti, is liye ret vibrate karte antinodes se hat kar saakin nodes par jama hoti hai aur standing wave ka pattern dikhati hai.

book_ref.quote: Hence, the sand will vibrate and shift from antinode to nodes because the nodes are stationary.

blocks.prompt:
75 Differentiate between nodes and antinodes on a vibrating Chladni plate.
(Vibrate karti Chladni plate par nodes aur antinodes mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Jab plate resonant frequency par vibrate kare to nodes aur antinodes bante hain.

book_ref.quote: When the plate is vibrated at the frequency of a resonant normal mode

rows: Woh points jahan plate vibrate nahi karti.
Woh points jahan plate zyada se zyada amplitude se vibrate karti hai.
Saakin, is liye ret wahan jama hoti hai.
Ret wahan se hat jaati hai.

blocks.prompt:
76 How does an acoustic levitator hold small particles in air?
(Acoustic levitator chhote zarron ko hawa mein kaise rokta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Transducer ki oonchi frequency (ultrasonic) aawaz reflector se palatti hai; aane wali aur palatne wali waves standing wave banati hain. Nodes (kam pressure) aur antinodes (zyada pressure) ka farq zarron ko gravity ke khilaaf dhakelta hai aur nodes par phansa deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The interaction between the incident and reflected waves forms a standing wave

blocks.prompt:
77 How does damping affect the amplitude and sharpness of resonance?
(Damping resonance ke amplitude aur sharpness par kya asar daalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono damping par munhasar hain: damping jitni kam, resonant amplitude utna zyada aur resonance utni sharp. Bohat damped system ka resonance curve kaafi chapta hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The amplitude as well as its sharpness, both depend upon the damping.

blocks.prompt:
78 Why does a lead bob show a much larger resonant amplitude than a pith ball of equal size on the same length?
(Barabar size aur lambai par lead bob pith ball se kaafi zyada resonant amplitude kyun dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono ko barabar lambai ka teesra pendulum chalata hai, is liye dono resonate karte hain. Magar hawa ki rukawat halki pith ball ko bhaari lead bob se kaafi zyada damp karti hai, aur kam damping zyada amplitude deti hai.

book_ref.quote: It is observed that amplitude of the lead bob is much greater than that of the pith-ball.

blocks.prompt:
79 What happened to the Tacoma Narrows Bridge in 1940, and what lesson does it teach?
(1940 mein Tacoma Narrows Bridge ke saath kya hua aur is se kya sabaq milta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Khulne ke taqreeban chaar mahine baad halki hawa ne pul mein resonant vibrations paida keen; chand ghanton mein amplitude itna barha ke aik hissa toot gaya. Sabaq: pulon aur civil engineering projects ke design mein resonance ka khayal zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: Only four months after this, a mild wind set up the bridge in resonant vibrations.
